source_record.title: Senior Software Engineer
source_record.description:
About Us

Nopan is a payment performance platform built by former merchants, focused exclusively on account and wallet payment methods. We help large merchants, fintechs, and PSPs turn payments into measurable revenue drivers. We are payments nerds who are excited about global changes happening in the industry and we want and know how to make it better. In just 18 months, we secured our license from the Dutch Central Bank, formed partnerships with Europe's major payment schemes, including becoming a Principal Member of EPI/Wero, and went live with initial customers. Backed by leading investors, we are now scaling to become the default performance layer for account and wallet payments in Europe. If you're excited about solving big problems and creating something from the ground up, this is the place for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with the founding team to define, design, and implement the core product.

  • Contribute to product strategy and roadmap discussions, bringing your technical expertise to the table.

  • Take ownership of entire features from conception to deployment, and iterate based on user feedback.

  • Set up and maintain the tech infrastructure, including cloud services, databases, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Set up data storage solutions and ensure data integrity and security.

  • Optimize system performance and scalability to support a growing user base.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development with a strong command of Java and related frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot).

  • Proven experience deploying and managing applications on AWS, utilizing services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications in production environments.

  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle ambiguity in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

  • Passion for building efficient and scalable systems from the ground up.

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Plus

  • Experience in payment processing or integrating with payment gateways, handling transactions, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations.

What’s in It for You

  • Join a passionate team of ex-Netflix, Visa, Microsoft veterans at the ground level and shape the company’s technology stack.

  • Be part of the founding team and have a significant impact on the direction of the company.

  • Equity in the company, allowing you to share in the success you help create.

  • Flexible work arrangements and a supportive work environment.

  • We support and invest in your growth, including covering the cost of relevant courses, certifications, and training programs.

  • Endless opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.
